author: Frost123
title: DeFANG'd: Dow Dumps Into Red For 2018 As Techs Tumble
text: in General It was hard for asset-gathering, commission-takers to argue this was "nothing"...While all the attention was on Facebook, Bloomberg notes there was a little more going on that spooked markets... Addition - FB - FANG - Trump/Mueller - Wednesday "In addition to FB, FANG & Trump/Mueller, Wednesday's FOMC raises possibility of four rate hikes. AAPL threatening supply chain if going w/ their own screens. To a lesser extent, Japanese polls showing Abe's popularity flagging in light of patronage scandal."The day started off poorly with European stocks triggering a death cross... Cash - Indices Cash indices were all ugly...Nasdaq suffers its biggest drop since the Feb crash (the week after the biggest retail fund inflow into Nasdaq ETFs since the peak in 2000)... 'breaks - Today Some not able 'breaks' today...Faceplant! - first close below 200DMA since 1/5/17... DeFANG Dow broke a key support level... Stocks - Shot FANGMAN Stocks were taken out back and shot...Bank stocks have erased all the post-Payrolls spike... VIX VIX surged up to almost 22 before being hit back below 20...And The VIX term structure...
